messages:
alex: FYI Hyperlane is hitting 95th+ token latency spikes after the runtime deploy yesterday, CS escalated. SLA risk — p95 up ~1.8x vs baseline. Need owners and a mitigation plan.

sara: Thanks Alex. Do we know if this lines up with the KV cache change that went out?

alex: Looks correlated with runtime v2.14. The PR changed batch timeout + prefix cache eviction. Repro in staging: `seq_len=512, qps=2` shows KV thrash and elevated tail latency.

maria: tagging @derek (runtime) and @jess (platform). Derek — can you confirm impact and suggest a quick mitigation?

derek: I saw the alert. We're seeing cache miss storms when requests cross model-shard boundaries after the eviction tweak. Short-term options: revert eviction policy (fast) or increase cache capacity (slower). Revert is quickest.

alex: Customer is in us-west but traffic fell back to eu-west. Revert timeline?

derek: I can prepare a revert PR and deploy to canary in ~30m. Need platform to pause the autoscaler override that triggers new instance provisioning (that increases shard churn).

jess: I can pause the override. Send PR link and exact service name.

derek: PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4892 — service: `runtime-pool-7`. Revert will set `eviction_policy=legacy`.

jess: paused autoscaler policy for `runtime-pool-7`. Let me know when canary is up.

derek: Revert deployed to canary at 1949991300. Sample logs:
```
2026-03-17T18:48:12Z INFO cache: eviction_policy=legacy
2026-03-17T18:48:33Z INFO batch: target_ms=12
```

maria: CS needs an ETA to tell Hyperlane and a fallback plan if rollback doesn't work.

sara: I'll update them: attempting rollback now, expect stabilization within 45m, will confirm in 20m. If rollback doesn't resolve it, we'll open a hotfix config change (ETA ~1h).

ops-bot: @oncall derek, incident created INC-2026-311 (priority: high)

derek: Taking ownership. If revert doesn't fully cut it, I'll escalate to runtime oncall and open a targeted hotfix. Also pinging @sam for quick CR review on the revert.

sam: I can do a quick +1 review in ~10m.

alex: Thanks — please update this thread with canary metrics and the PROD push plan. Also add notes to the incident doc: https://confluence.redwood/INC-2026-311

sara: Updated Hyperlane: ETA 45m, we will follow up within 20m.

maria: I'll prep a postmortem template in case we breach SLA; tagging eng-sre for observability retention.

derek: Canary shows p95 down ~30% at 1949991360. I'm pushing revert to prod now.

jess: Prod deploy started at 1949991382. Autoscaler override still paused.

derek: Prod back to healthy — p95 within SLO at 1949991425. Monitoring for 30m.

sara: Hyperlane confirmed service recovered. Closing escalation pending postmortem.

alex: Closing this thread — great response team work. Leaving follow-ups in the incident doc. :tada:
